Restaurant Pier 11

Welcome to Restaurant Pier 11. Enjoy a fusion of Swedish home-cooked meals and global favors. Our menu is all about fresh seasonal ingredients, offering a mix of international dishes with a creative twist. Take your pick from five unique dishes, along with a colorful salad buffet and tasty desserts.

Café Pier 11

The café is open Monday to Friday 08:00-15:00
